propositions: Maintained guidance in public documentation, docstrings, and developer comments incorrectly describe plan-review, completion-verifier, and verify-signature behavior as HMAC-based when they now implement asymmetric DSSE/SSHSIG operation-certificates with Ed25519 and environment attribution.

Generic HMAC helpers (compute_signature, verify_record, signing-key utilities) remain supported and must not be relabeled, while HMAC guidance for the two gated operation-certificate kinds (plan-review and completion-verifier) must be corrected to reflect the current asymmetric model.
Historical ADRs, migration records, and experiment corpora must remain unchanged; generated references must be regenerated through canonical sources (gen_mcp_reference.py, gen_cli_reference.py) only.
Legacy HMAC plan-review and completion-verifier records remain readable for backward compatibility but cannot certify a current gated operation and must be documented as such.
